newsitems.contents: [p]Howdy y'all! [/p][p][/p][p][b]FEAR FEAR WEST IS OUT NOW!!![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a012990849bc2b215409d6ead19455256ac47141.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're super excited to get this one out into your wonderful hands! We've put a lot of hard work into today's update and hope y'all enjoy it. Please let us know what you think! [/p][previewyoutube="2iKcr9NFCAg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]ALSO!! DISCOUNT!![/h2][p]Starting [b]RIGHT NOW,[/b] and for the next two weeks, Far Far West will also be going on sale for 20% off its usual price! So if you've been holding out on some spooky new content before jumping into the game, now might just be the time ;D[/p][p][/p][h2]FEAR FEAR WEST EVENT[/h2][hr][/hr][p][b]The Halloween event is here![/b] [/p][p]This means 3 new time-limited objectives, [b]a new Halloween boss with exclusive attack patterns,[/b] a bunch of [b]skins to unlock,[/b] and rituals to perform![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/ed10e3817b7d743b99ea812b00008b4e5c2fe412.png"][/img][/p][h2]🎯 [b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h2][p]The event takes place across all maps, with contracts on the mission selection listing if they have Halloween objectives or not[/p][p]Each of these missions features up to 2 of the 3 unique resources, and each one has its own dedicated gameplay: [b]🪶 Feathers[/b], [b]🎃 Pumpkins,[/b] and 💀 [b]Skulls[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🪶 Feathers[/b]: find a crow statue and shoot the fleeing crow[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎃 Pumpkins[/b]: kill the Halloween Boss[/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]Skulls[/b]: find a haunted cemetery and destroy the flying skulls[/p][/*][/list][p]Back in the lobby, head to the cauldron behind the train and use your resources to perform the ritual[/p][p]Performing a ritual will reward you with [b]🕯️Haunted Candles[/b], the event’s unique currency, which you can spend on Halloween-limited cosmetics![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b260ce84ce15c8d8753039cd4a77f4d1302b7b6b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🪙 WHAT CAN I GAIN FROM THIS EVENT?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/64a4e293000ddf4fb4a058ab9ad865ff5f403574.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Character skin [b]Sawbones[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Character skin [b]Scarecrow[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Character skin [b]Pumpkin Jack[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Mount skin [b]Ghost[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Title [b]Dies First[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Title [b]Scarecrow[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Title [b]Bounty Haunter[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Title [b]Legend of the Fear Fear West[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Emote [b]Spooked[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Emote [b]Ritual[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]👻 WHAT HAPPENS TO ALL MY STUFF WHEN THE EVENT ENDS?[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]🪶 Feathers[/b], [b]🎃 Pumpkins,[/b] and 💀 [b]Skulls[/b] will be deleted from your inventory[/p][/*][*][p][b]🕯️Haunted Candles[/b] will be converted into [b]🍥 Souls[/b] at a [b]1🕯️ = 2[/b]🍥 rate[/p][/*][/list][p]All cosmetics you have unlocked are yours forever. Those you haven’t unlocked will be [b]available to buy with Gold after the event ends[/b], at 4 times the price of cosmetics of the same category[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]FEATURES/CONTENT[/h1][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]⚔️ JOKER’S CHOICE[/b][/h2][p]A small change, but one that feels BIG! [/p][p]The pool of Jokers keeps getting wider, which means your chances of landing one that fits your build keep going down. Since melee and gun weapons often have their own specific Jokers, you’ll more and more often land one that’s completely useless to you, and that can only be broken down for Uranium or swapped at the Refiner. [/p][p][b]We’re changing that![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/e5ddda6da9cfce902780d8d0a7492730ee5e6ef9.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Collecting a Joker is now instantaneous[/p][/*][*][p]When collecting a Joker, an interface will pop up and let you choose between 2 Jokers of the same rarity[/p][/*][*][p]All other Joker features remain unchanged[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🚨 DISTURBANCE[/b][/h2][p]We’re introducing scaling difficulty to Far Far West! [/p][p]As players progressed through a mission and got stronger by collecting Jokers, it could feel like enemies were no longer a challenge, and the game got less fun as a result. We want players to still feel like they’ve become powerful, so the scaling is modest and should only serve to make missions a little more exciting and chaotic, rather than directly making the game more difficult. [/p][p]For those who want difficulty, expect more challenge on new, higher difficulties in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Completing specific actions during a mission will raise your Disturbance Level. At certain thresholds, enemies will be buffed for the rest of the mission[/p][h3][b]HOW TO INCREASE DISTURBANCE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Activate a Lighthouse: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Finish a Quest: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Start an Anvil: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Kill a Miniboss: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Activate an Easy Modifier: +5%[/p][/*][*][p]Activate a Classic Modifier: +10%[/p][/*][*][p]Finish the Main Objective: +10%[/p][/*][*][p]Complete a Side Objective: +15%[/p][/*][*][p]Trigger a Storm Trap: +15%[/p][/*][*][p]Kill the Boss: +30%[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUFF EFFECTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]35% Disturbance:[/b] enemies move 5% faster[/p][/*][*][p][b]70% Disturbance:[/b] enemies move 15% faster[/p][/*][*][p][b]100% Disturbance:[/b] enemies move 30% faster and the spawner boss gains +10% health[/p][list][*][p]Triggers [b]🌀 Modifier Ragestorm[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🌀 MODIFIERS[/b][/h2][p]Our modifier system has been through a lot of iterations during testing - in our previous devlogs, we showed off modifiers being directly tied to Disturbance Level, as a mandatory random challenge in every mission. [/p][p]We felt this system wasn’t very friendly to casual players, and warped the game too much to be left up to random chance. This new system is fully opt-in, making you ask yourself: dare you strike a deal with the Dealmaker?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/fb0a7e303458e75a66b0f2c1d5572d0d4c7153f6.png"][/img][/p][p]Modifiers can be activated within the game by finding and interacting with up to two [b]Dealmakers[/b]. Each Dealmaker will offer you 2 modifiers to choose from, each modifier giving XP and Uranium based on its difficulty. The third modifier offered is random and has fixed rewards.[/p][p]XP from Modifiers are applied to both your hero and weapons. If a modifier provides +500XP, you will individually gain +500XP on your hero, +500XP on your main weapon, and +500XP on your secondary weapon.[/p][list][*][p][b]Dealmakers[/b] can be revealed by completing the Lighthouse[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dealmakers[/b] offer less rewards for each Disturbance Level threshold that has been reached[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Dealmakers[/b] will vanish after you have completed the main objective, so make sure you have seen their deals beforehand![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]ODDS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]NORMAL[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌀 80% Easy[/b] / [b]🌀 20% What goes up must come down, preferably on someone.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a833a5d5f54ca147deb96efd14b5f349ec2d936c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Right-click:[/b] Dive to the ground while flying the Jetpack to release a damaging burst on nearby enemies[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UNIQUE][/b] [b]\[⚪⚪] TRAIL PACK:[/b] Your jetpack trail leaves elemental puddles[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UNIQUE][/b] [b]\[⚪⚪⚪⚪] CRASH PACK:[/b] Double the fuel ammo, but half the flight duration[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UNIQUE][/b] [b]\[⚪⚪⚪⚪⚪] HOVER PACK:[/b] Divebomb is replaced with a hover boost that costs fuel and swaps your weapon[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]👵 WOODLANDS QUESTLINE[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0819a2e697fdb37e836663994d639501e8ef656e.png"][/img][/p][p]Lady Granny can’t wait to exploit you in her new ventures in the Woodlands! Be a good intern, and she’ll reward you well![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🌳 NEW MAP: REDWOOD[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/606afcd4134b33c13f239ff674efcf74f4b1cdae.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A brand new map has appeared, dark, mysterious, full of trees and… enemies, as always![/p][/*][*][p]A strange cauldron has also made its way into the woods… Wonder what it’s for…[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🪚 NEW MAIN OBJECTIVE: GIANT BUZZSAW[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/22d3c42954a419f2eb58b76bab94807dfa623320.png"][/img][/p][p]A new main objective is available in the rotation! Who doesn’t dream of slicing through the boss spawner with a giant buzzsaw?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🐎 HORSE RACE[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/96d9ce298e9b17358fd2ca8f3c8b45180de91e85.png"][/img][/p][p]Head to the fields behind the cemetery to compete in a horse race with your teammates! Who’s the finest rider in the West?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]BALANCE[/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]WEAPONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔼 [b]Revolver[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base damage increased from 13 to 15[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Bow[/b][/p][list][*][p]Arrow damage at max bend increased from 30 to 40[/p][/*][*][p]Can now equip the following Jokers: [b]Speedster[/b] and [b]Joker Trick[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Banjo[/b][/p][list][*][p]XP gained from healing increased from 1 to 2 per restored HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Boomerang[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base damage increased from 6 to 7[/p][/*][*][p]Can now equip the following Jokers: [b]Panic Attack[/b], [b]Anti-Gravity Falls[/b] and [b]Vampire[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The Boomerang no longer sticks to allies[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Sheriff Stars[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base damage increased from 20 to 22[/p][/*][*][p]Base ammo increased from 15 to 20[/p][/*][*][p]Pickup range upgrade increased from 7% to 10% per slot[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Healing Area (Utility)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Duration increased from 30 to 60 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]JOKERS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔼 [b]\[FINE] PRECIOUS RUSH:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Speed increased from [b]54%[/b] to [b]60%[/b] [i](the 54% was supposed to be 25%, but we made a mistake, good for you!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Rings are no longer collected automatically, press the Interact key on them to collect them[/p][/*][*][p][i]Precious Rush didn’t feel like it offered the player much choice in passing up on the effect if they preferred their vision over the speed bonus. We hope this change will make picking up a ring feel like an intentional decision rather than a sudden change in scenery - and we’re keeping the speed, so zoom to your heart’s content![/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[FINE] WELL FED:[/b] [i]+5 HP[/i] > +7 HP[/p][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[PRIME] CHEAPSKATE:[/b] [i]Gain +1 HP for every 20 Gold in your mission inventory, up to +15 HP[/i] > Gain +1 HP for every 15 Gold in your mission inventory, up to +20 HP[/p][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[PRIME] SCRUB HIT:[/b] Rarity reduced from [b]PRIME[/b] to [b]FINE[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[MYTHIC] LAZY:[/b] Rarity reduced from [b]MYTHIC[/b] to [b]PRIME[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔽 [b]\[MYTHIC] THICK SKIN:[/b] Max available from 2 to 1[/p][list][*][p][i]We’ve been keeping a close eye on Frost and shield builds after Frostburn’s release, and we’re glad that its proven itself as a solid alternative playstyle, using jokers like Thick Skin, Death’s Dance, and Frost Mastery together to generate large amounts of SP and boost damage output with All Mighty. This nerf is intended to adjust this build’s scaling and bring its power level closer to other builds when you first start a mission, without affecting the individual strength of each Joker and allowing it to scale back to its previous heights.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[UNIQUE] FIST RO DAH:[/b] [i]The charged attack propels you backwards and has a 20% chance to apply Frost to enemies[/i] > The charged attack propels you backwards and applies Frost to enemies[/p][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[UNIQUE] SKY LASH:[/b] Reduced slot cost from 4 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]\[UNIQUE] BARDBARIAN:[/b] Reduced slot cost from 5 to 4[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]\[UNIQUE] ULTRADRAW:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Explosion damage reduced from 35 to 20 (explosion radius unchanged)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced slot cost from 7 to 4[/p][/*][*][p][i]Our previous changes to Ultradraw didn’t quite have the effect we were hoping for. They only served to make the Joker even more restricted to specific builds, thanks to its steep slot cost. As a result, we’re taking Ultradraw in a new, experimental direction, with a large reduction in both the Joker’s power level and cost. We’re not entirely sure if this will be an effective change, so please get in our feedback channels and let us know![/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]OBJECTIVES & STORMS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔼 [b]Overloaded TNT[/b] and [b]Nuclear Missile[/b] main objectives:[/p][list][*][p]Storms are now infinite and only end when the objective’s initial progress bar is completely filled[/p][/*][*][p]In practice, the Overloaded TNT objective will require players to restore factory power before the storm concludes, and the Nuclear Missile’s storm length is slightly extended[/p][/*][*][p][i]These two are the oldest objectives in the game and have needed an update for a while now. We want the main objective to be the third hardest part of each mission (right behind the boss and extraction), and finite storms didn’t hit the mark for that. Giving these objectives infinite storms fully brings Overloaded TNT to modern standards, and although Nuclear Missile lacks any mid-storm elements to prolong the event, the increased duration should still spice things up a bit.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🔼 [b]Cryptic Totem[/b] & [b]Anvil[/b]: Added arena domes during storms that lock players in the objective area[/p][/*][*][p]🔽 [b]Kamikaze storms:[/b] Reduced the number of Kamikazes that spawn[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]Wishing Well:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The outcome that spawned a modifier has been replaced with one that raises the mission’s Disturbance Level[/p][/*][*][p]Now has an outcome that grants free Uranium[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]ENEMIES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🔽 [b]Cryptic Lich:[/b] HP scaling with difficulty reduced from 0.25 to 0.1 [i](Liches are easier to kill on higher difficulties)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]🔽 [b]Cryptic Kamikaze:[/b] Screaming audio range slightly increased[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]BOSSES[/b][/h3][p]Our bosses have been around since the very beginning, and while the game has updated and evolved so much since then, they’ve stayed relatively the same until now. We want bosses to feel like the “final showdown” before extraction, and offer more challenge for players on higher difficulties. While we didn’t get to the Cryptic Train this update, expect it to receive a similar overhaul in the future, and expect new bosses to have this standard of quality and polish![/p][p][/p][p][b]🔁 autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0600ab5d2841ba9a1c307ecb9cc8906763904d29.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/50a4e7f431899d73d74f559ec5d8060f2538a6a0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/fe8fc384e41300a27a50fb8f357d8019551f34fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b73c29dff5956cfc384f59e9c641f7e7fd263aa2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]New classic skins![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/90bc2e1ca6bebe24ab3f084528eec1140ac4c61b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]All maps and a lot of points of interest have gone through a spookification pass![/b][/h2][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/425106c6c385b04ee1e6204cb63cbac340a066aa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/64d4008742cd34cfd7625d567d50cfdf30a7ed69.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2b0a6e9abfbacaf477bb0324cce11d4a04b08b9e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/dcbe3a8b84d7af42f9c587e62a0654f36e467bbd.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]Decals Update[/b][/h2][p]Decals such as dirt or moss no longer mess with the geometry of meshes, and most of them now appear smooth even with decals enabled[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]BUGFIXES[/h1][hr][/hr][p][i]Very minor bugfixes and tweaks are not listed[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed 50+ bugs, including:[/p][list][*][p]Multiple crash and disconnection issues have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a frequent GPU crash at game startup on RTX 4060 cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ronsau:[/b] should no longer stay at his base during Quest 1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arizona Jones:[/b] should no longer interrupt her door-unlocking animation to draw her weapon when enemies are nearby, which could block the questline in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p][b]Banjo:[/b] aiming down sights should no longer slow the camera when right-clicking[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where explosions from the joker ‘Clutch’ and ‘Mindshot’ dealt self-damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies clipping through the ground[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Relentless:[/b] stacking multiple copies now properly grants +30% damage per extra copy instead of +130%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Magic Friendship:[/b] now specifies the exact HP restored in its description[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Death’s Dance:[/b] now correctly reduces SP decay speed by the listed 30% instead of 50%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Tin Man:[/b] should now only convert the excess healing instead of granting the full shield value when using Banjo’s healing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Spell Roulette:[/b] should no longer reroll a spell you already have[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Swamp Trick:[/b] the explosions it triggers on the Dual Revolvers should no longer damage you[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Bardbarian:[/b] rapid follow-up attack inputs after a slam should no longer softlock you into an unintended second slam animation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Fanning Ace:[/b] a high reload speed should no longer prevent it from triggering on consecutive reloads, so it can properly be chained[/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Jump Star:[/b] the extra jumps should no longer persist after switching away from the Sheriff Stars[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]QUALITY OF LIFE / MISC[/b][/h1][hr][/hr][h3][b]DISCONNECTIONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We traced disconnections to the way the UE5 Steam plugin handles unstable connections. While we did some work to address that, we have ultimately decided to move away from Steam sessions for matchmaking and are now using Epic Online Services. This change should be invisible to the end user, but it resolves the Steam connection issues[/p][/*][*][p]Client jokers and spent Uranium are saved when disconnected from a session, allowing clients to reconnect and keep their loot[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]CONTROLS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The gamepad has received some love. It’s still using a virtual cursor driven by stick input, but the cursor can now snap to button locations when navigating between menus[/p][/*][*][p]Input remapping has been reworked to allow multiple binds for the same action on PC, and to let you rebind gamepad buttons[/p][/*][*][p]The drop key is now bound to Reload by default, and can be rebound in the settings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]GAMBA MACHINE[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When gambling more than once every 30 seconds at the gamba machine, your rolls are much faster[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell a Joker directly after gambling it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]PROMO CODES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Text box wont register key presses held when before opening the window so no more FFFFFFFFFF promo codes[/p][/*][*][p]Copy/paste supported[/p][/*][*][p]Tab no longer breaks the code screen[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing enter during text entry acts as confirmation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]MISC[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved CPU load for enemies. This improves performance, especially for the host and especially in high difficulty missions with a lot of enemies at once[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer hit an enemy AND a player at the same time with a melee weapon. This should make messy fights much easier for melee users[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jukebox to replace the gramophone in the lobby that plays songs directly, without needing to pick up and use individual discs[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Self healing” and “Team healing” stats to the end-of-game screen[/p][/*][*][p]The Horseman will now spawn only if you are close enough, preventing far-off Marauders from shooting them down[/p][/*][*][p]Join code box accepts only 5 alpha characters, confirmation disabled until a 5 character code is entered[/p][/*][*][p]The Coyote now drops Uranium instead of Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened the cactus dialogue for the Desert secret so the hint on where to find them appears in the first line[/p][/*][*][p]New stingers for boss kills, exploration music, chest openings, lighthouses, objectives, and more! [i](stingers are ~3 second sounds played when you accomplish something, or used to end a track or transition between two of them)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New fanart has been added to the cave![/p][/*][*][p][b]Cryptic shockwaves:[/b] the decal no longer grows with the size and the supporting flames last longer, for a more accurate hitbox and better visual clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]NEW RAPTORS[/b][/h2][p]With this patch, we’re welcoming 2 new Evil Raptor members who joined us since Frostburn dropped![/p][list][*][p][b]Jonathan[/b] is our new gameplay designer, tasked with designing and implementing new enemies and bosses, as well as reworking the Cryptic bosses![/p][/*][*][p][b]Telurik[/b] is the artist behind almost all the music in Far Far West! The electro banjo madness? That’s him! Telurik is now back with us part-time instead of from time to time, which means even more banger tracks coming in the next few months 🤌[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]The Far Far West Official Soundtrack is OUT![/h2][p][/p][p]You can listen and grab it on a whole bunch of platforms, available right there:[/p][p][url="https://kidkatana.ffm.to/far-far-west-ost"]https://kidkatana.ffm.to/far-far-west-ost[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Soon available on Steam![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]And that's everythin' from the Fear Fear West update! [/p][p][/p][p]If you made it this far, thanks for readin’! Let us know what you think of this update, and we’ll see y’all out in the spooky Fear (Fear) West![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Follow us through the West![/b][/h2][h3]Don’t forget to [b][u][url="https://linktr.ee/FarFarWest"]follow our socials[/url][/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]JOIN OUR DISCORD[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/5ba6a99656c37eddfc71ffc6093667e4dcf6d3f3.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]And [b]review[/b] FFW on Steam!! newsitems.author: Damian
newsitems.contents: [p]Howdy Y'all![/p][p]Get ready to step into [b]FEAR FEAR WEST[/b] on [b]October 22nd,[/b] when we'll be launching a limited-time seasonal event to celebrate spooky season AND an update to the game at the same time :D[/p][p][/p][p]Expect bug fixes, new content, system changes, and optimization improvements in the [b]FEAR FEAR WEST[/b] Update!!![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jgE9S_Ix40c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]A Frightful Limited-Time Event[/h2][p]From [b]22nd October[/b] to [b]12th November[/b], you can collect resources, complete the ritual, and claim Haunted Candles to unlock new [b]Halloween cosmetics[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]These cosmetics will continue to be [b]permanently available[/b] [b]after the Halloween event ends![/b] (no FOMO here!) However, they will be priced at a [b]much higher amount of gold than regular skins of the same rarity, [/b]meaning unlocking them during the Halloween event will be much faster![/p][p][/p][h2]The Far Far West Original Soundtrack Arrives[/h2][p]The Far Far West Original Soundtrack will also be released on 22nd October across all major platforms (including Steam!). And we'll be hosting a Listening party on the 21st of October (More details on this coming soon!)[/p][p] [/p][p]So mark your calendars for [b]October 22nd[/b] and get ready for a spooky ride in Fear Fear West![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Follow our Spooky Socials[/b][/h2][p](they're not that spooky, but it's Halloween so...)[/p][p][url="https://linktr.ee/FarFarWest"][b]FOLLOW US ON EVERYTHING (boo)![/b][/url][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/farfarwest"][b]JOIN OUR SPOOKY DISCORD[/b][/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/5ba6a99656c37eddfc71ffc6093667e4dcf6d3f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]And pls leave a spooky review on Steam[/b] [i](maybe after the new update)[/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124540/Far_Far_West/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

newsitems.title: DEVLOG - OCTOBER
newsitems.author: adelma
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello folks, Arno here! In this devlog, we’ll go more in-depth on our upcoming Halloween event, show a bunch of new things coming in the next update, and follow up on a few themes from previous devlogs![/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Everything below is [b]WORK IN PROGRESS[/b] and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT[/h1][p]Our Halloween event is [i]clooooooose[/i]! We’ve only been teasing it lightly so far, but we finally have more to share with you! Here’s what to expect: new time-limited objectives, a bunch of skins to unlock, resources to collect, rituals to accomplish, and a brand new Halloween-exclusive boss![/p][p]The Halloween event will be available on 3 maps: [b]Far West[/b], [b]Area 41,[/b] and the new [b]Redwood[/b] map[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ We’ve changed our minds about how event cosmetics are unlocked compared to what we announced in our previous Devlog.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3124540/view/710035156415545611?l=english"][/dynamiclink]We thought vaulting the Halloween skins until next year’s event was a reasonable choice, and that it helped make the event feel special. But at the end of the day, that’s still FOMO, and we don’t want FOMO. So, Halloween cosmetics will NOT be vaulted when the event ends. Instead, they’ll go back to a gold price, but a much higher one than other cosmetics of the same category. This way the Halloween event stays the best and fastest way to unlock them, without being the only one! ⚠️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/23de7784cf09d30c9fe371e33cceccc81fd9154d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/70caeb04e02bfe72ca3734ad24ce9cfe86c5e942.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b9f011639663ae637f340d863bf02d364297833f.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/c1791a9812b3ef3d386c4e079a2c0b423ece83d6.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concept and 3D by @Capp, rig and texture by @Adrian, animation by @Calu[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The event will make you go through all 3 maps to collect exclusive Halloween resources, which you’ll then use to accomplish rituals in the lobby and earn the Halloween currency needed to unlock new skins![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/79583fcd1944d18d5f5b6ab7b0dc8cc9b6e88095.png"][/img][i]The ominous cauldron in the lobby / Level Art by @Borealis[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/d0dcf83ab3afff25b93d086e26cb7711899e1f1a.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]WIP Ritual accomplishment VFX / Animated and programmed by @Spinker, VFX by @me[/i][/p][p][/p][p]For the new objectives and skins, we wanted something crooked, dark and naughty. A bunch of [i]~spooooooooky~[/i] assets were made for the occasion![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2f2f84176a13f0de3a43693fa0a58c33df74ee9e.png"][/img][i]Concept by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/489f65e5fab3dffa296bfd13f9e4458ff8b1287c.png"][/img][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt, rig and WIP texture by @Adrian[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/1c2a33324bc36b77294f1768c5d57c7f626afacf.png"][/img][i]A new horse skin! / Concept by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/228e7017e6f96be3851cc6c5e8d0b60927f62bef.png"][/img][i]Concept, 3D and high-poly by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/9296494877b50c66077041fb2e07b1585bb597b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Concept by @Capp, 3D by @Capp, @MashArt, @Spinker, high-poly and rig by @Adrian[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🪚NEW MAIN OBJECTIVE[/h1][p]A new main objective is making its way into the Far Far West! This is our first step into adding new objectives, but definitely not the last! We’ll keep adding new main and secondary objectives in the coming updates to extend the existing pool and make sure every mission stays fresh. [b]VERY WIP!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/97a66adf7d41e84e312930809797fc25a310ec0f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/981aaed2b6132985d4c1ba7cbecbf2cde3edf961.png"][/img][i]WIP!! / Programmed by @Spinker[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👵 GRANNY’S QUESTS[/h1][p]Granny’s getting impatient: you still haven’t done a thing for her while she rests behind the counter, counting her coins. 3 quests are currently being wrapped up, and completing them will unlock the Redwood map! She will make you work. Hard.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/4cab9d0da19af24bb7344d7445b951dbac5ccc67.png"][/img][i]Lady Granny Quest 2 / Designed by @me, programmed by @Mylan[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/01a89362ec2e0c47bd537d145db953277711f663.png"][/img][i]Lady Granny Quest 3 / Designed by @Spinker and @me, programmed by @Mylan and @Spinker[/i][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/7272316125669589c3905dc40ee9ab9ef8a9b33b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2e306304fd49a3a40495ee168072cacaefbbf0ee.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🌳 REDWOOD MAP[/h1][p]We finished the Redwood map, at last! It wasn’t an easy ride: the first time we thought it was done, we playtested it and… it didn’t work out. The map was gigantic and lacked detail on the ground, which made you feel like really small. It was also quite painful to traverse, and even a bit exhausting, enough that we were reluctant to do another run on the map. That’s definitely not what we’re aiming for in our maps, and we always want to be happy with what we deliver, even if it sets us back a few days or weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Following this, we decided to cut the map by almost 40%, making areas narrower and more interesting to traverse, scaling down a bunch of meshes and adding a TON of vegetation. The map now feels like it belongs in Far Far West and is a blast to go through, while keeping its own unique features compared to the other maps!
[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f71b6fcd11b5c5dac655a67baa6d2b8b0bf523d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/241504485b89b3d2d07f4735ab0f30144ae21b89.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/19464d0614dd27b206057d9995ea4612030ae24e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/6f436375fdab04fdb60342aa502b4eecab2cd3c0.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Atmosphere by @Spinker, level art by @Borealis[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👻 SPOOKYFICATION[/h1][p]In continuation of our goal to spookify the game a lil’ bit, a few points of interest and a handful of spots across the maps were overhauled, either because they were old and not up to par with how we do things now, or because they simply deserved to get spookied. This spookifying mission will continue in the coming updates, so expect more locations to get a makeover over time! Some Halloween-specific decorations may even stick around after the event ends.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a26d7fed4ef8b36b1ebe04293c7a1952d9ae964c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/4b945e64682a0273f7b31bf8d62e466d27ba6a91.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Point of interest / By @Borealis[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/908122beb6f8d9e2b0c804eb1d2ba26be3bb516c.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Point of interest / By @Borealis[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/4ad07c221d77c5faaeb6affd94b4bef2d42b524a.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Far West map church makeover / By @Borealis[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🎶 ELECTRO… BANJO?[/h1][p][b]Telurik[/b] is the artist behind almost all the music in Far Far West! The electro banjo madness? That’s him! Telurik is now back with us part-time instead of from time to time, which means even more banger tracks coming in the next few months 🤌 And what better way to celebrate than a lil’ tease of the upcoming Halloween boss theme… 🎃[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wDG537OHdyk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🐎 HORSE RAAAAAACE[/h1][p]A new mini-game has spawned in the lobby, and it’s NOT fishing! You can now race horses against your friends, soon to be enemies, and find out who’s the finest rider in the Far Far West 💨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/d8e308076d8f34706eb03b0eb177a768e498713d.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]WIP! / Designed and programmed by @Spinker[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]📰 SMALL THINGS![/h1][p]We received a bunch of feedback about the [b]Anna Wooltour[/b] skin from our previous [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3124540/view/710035156415545611?l=english"]Devlog[/url][/b], especially about her head compared to her original design by @EarlGoupil (community). So we’ve remade her head in a way that fits the original design a bit better![/p][p][/p][p][b]BEFORE[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/cbe438edc7ece4a4e4b5a3779d687083c77f5a4e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]AFTER[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/43fd38abe0e2235a6b527dd3ef6af190f0a112a1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b6e21cfc86d8137006f490f909e8327a2e0a5834.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/24fd4c8bac7f0e36f5bba14a3b78ea4d2b31f4fe.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]By @Capp and @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Disturbance system and the modifiers that go along with it were presented in our previous devlog, but they were still WIP at the time. Well, here’s a batch of new icons made just for the new modifiers, as well as a few WIP names to chew on![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/125d60e9a2483f79b565f7bab496d91917560a1c.png"][/img][i]Modifier icons by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Also… we’re having seasonal title screens from now on![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/8cf7b6bd82f6cb450f62e8a0e9925b8afa49ac5d.png"][/img][i]Background by @Borealis[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]👋 SEE YOU LATER![/h1][hr][/hr][p]Happy start of the spooky season![/p][p][/p][p][b]THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next one. Arno 🎩[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]😏 CM TAKEOVER!!![/b][/h1][hr][/hr][p]Howdy y'all, Damian here - FFW's Community Manager [/p][p]
I just wanted to sneak in ([i]don't tell Arno[/i]) to tell y'all that we have started releasing regular dev VLOGS!!! Alongside our usual dev blogs over on YouTube. Be sure to check them out! :D[/p][p][/p][h3][b]THIS TIMES[/b][/h3][previewyoutube="enN5neVD9eY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]LAST TIMES[/b][/h3][previewyoutube="oGwtgZvdi9I;full"][/previewyoutube]

newsitems.title: DEVLOG - SEPTEMBER - 02
newsitems.author: Damian | Fireshine Games
newsitems.contents:
[p]Hello folks, Arno here! [/p][p]In this devlog, we’re talking about new systems, difficulty, replayability, reworks, as well as a lot of new cool visual things to look at while we’re preparing for our Halloween update![/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Everything below is [b]WORK IN PROGRESS[/b] and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🃏 JOKERS CHOICE![/h2][p]A small change, but one that feels BIG! The pool of Jokers keeps getting wider, which means your chances of landing one that fits your build keep going down. Since melee and gun weapons often have their own specific Jokers, it happens more and more that a Joker is completely useless to you and has to be either broken down for Uranium or swapped at the Refiner. Well, you’ll now get to choose between 2 Jokers every time one drops![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/6ebdae5fba7f8973c1305f3b5b74086f76464a55.png"][/img][i]Design and implementation by @Spinker[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Obviously, having more choices also means that you’ll more often have a build that fits you, and thus the game will be easier in general. Well, don’t worry, difficulty is also a big topic of this devlog and of the next update! Let’s go to the second topic ⏩[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]⛈️[/b] DISTURBANCE SYSTEM - DIFFICULTY / REPLAYABILITY[/h2][p]We’ve been wondering about the current state of the difficulty in Far Far West for quite some time, and considering we have a diverse range of players, everybody has a different opinion on what the difficulty should be. Before making any change, we thought it was wise to ask you on different platforms whether you felt Far Far West needed to be more difficult. The poll answers as well as discussions that ensued were extremely interesting, and just as planned, pretty much everyone wants something different. We are also aware that a big part of our community is made of casual players who do not follow us on socials, and that, being casual players, they would probably lean towards not wanting the game to be harder. We’re taking this into account too! So how do we please everyone? [i]We can’t[/i]. But we’ll do our best to make as many people happy as possible![/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/c45a15bada211406aac03024e8a2fc39df3c8ed5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/264d26241ad58eb58f573f6f19b375e50500542c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b961a6a479d9902eeead7e23e3ee36b5b3923a16.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Discord vote / Reddit vote / Twitter vote[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Both a replayability and difficulty system at once, the Disturbance system will arrive with the next update! Disturbance will take into account what you accomplish on the map, and at some point will apply a modifier to your game. What, you thought the Overseer was just sassy and not doing anything all this time, just waiting for his minions to be defeated? He was preppin’ his modifiers, indeed![/p][p][/p][p]Modifiers will be separated into two categories, “Easy” and “Hard”, and the modifiers that are applied will be based on the difficulty of the mission selected and the tier of Disturbance reached. In practice, the higher the difficulty you choose, the harder the modifiers you get. This allows us to make sure the base difficulty of the game is not impacted too much at any difficulty level, while still adding a ton of replayability for everyone. Along with the Joker choice coming in the next update as well, we believe this increase in difficulty is going to balance itself out and make most people happy![/p][p][/p][p][i]Thanks to everyone who participated and shared modifier ideas in our Discord, we read everything and a bunch made their way into the game![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a670313d78b9e7150e529ed7aa708cd7ed3da751.png"][/img][i]Disturbance & modifiers can be tracked next to your minimap[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/6cedae7f11732fa081b1df97c9b6a22201bffd92.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Gary’s modifier. He’s Gary. Programmed by @Spinker[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/ce62f736c889975c0e53d6ddc3b2ae10e02eb16b.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Farmyard modifier. They’re bad, bad chickens. Programmed by @Spinker[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Still, this update on difficulty is not enough of a challenge for a bunch of people, and we hear ya! At this stage, we’re still considering adding a new difficulty level above Nightmare that would be extremely difficult and unfair, and not supposed to be played by most people. The goal of this difficulty would be to offer a real challenge to the best Far Far West players, without touching all the other difficulties, and therefore all the players who already find the game hard enough. Stay tuned![/p][p][i]This is the first step towards end-game content, but definitely not the last![/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]☠️ CRYPTIC BOSSES REWORK[/h2][p]As stated in our [url="https://farfarwest.notion.site/p/PUBLIC-ROADMAP-3bd64c4ffa1080879561e5c6bbf6dada?pvs=24"]🚅[u][b]PUBLIC ROADMAP[/b][/u][/url], Cryptic bosses are getting reworked, considering how the game has evolved since release and everything we’ve learned from your feedback. You can expect them to have more patterns, to be less frustrating and overall more interesting! Here’s a deeper dive into our changes for the Saloon and the Vulture, and you can expect the same level of work on the Necromancer and the Train.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/1e51f9e51dea73c385e7c1fa4331a09343121fb9.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/dbea64f0737b439efed1d1fcf439e295e28ddd8c.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/e09dc799b44015d2453a87d0672ead9edcb28aa6.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Rig by @Adrian, animation by @Calu, patterns by @Jonathan, Gameplay by @Arno[/i][/p][p][/p][p][u]⭐ [b]What is wrong with current Saloon?[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]It can be damaged only through its planks, rendering most builds inefficient and frustrating to use against[/p][/*][*][p]It has no evolution between difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]The second phase with the saloon spirit is boring but also confusing for first-time players[/p][/*][*][p]Not really a monster house fantasy?[/p][/*][/list][p][u]⭐ [b]What do we change?[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]It can now be damaged everywhere, planks remain through the fight and are now used as weakspots[/p][/*][*][p]New patterns for Very Hard and Nightmare, the boss cycle through attacks with a speed based on difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]No second phase anymore[/p][/*][*][p]New animations, new patterns and overall more visual clarity![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/9170a069604159962a6db29145b7bfa1da67fda1.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Rig by @Adrian, animation by @Calu, patterns by @Jonathan, Gameplay by @Arno[/i][/p][p][/p][p]⭐ [b]What is wrong with current Vulture?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The boss never moves[/p][/*][*][p]It has no evolution between difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]It has some frustrating patterns, such as the shield that can take some time to destroy[/p][/*][*][p]Some attacks are borderline useless, such as the summon of ravens (did you even know it existed?)[/p][/*][/list][p]⭐ [b]What do we change?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The boss now has new patterns that make it move around the arena[/p][/*][*][p]New patterns for Very Hard and Nightmare, the boss cycle through attacks with a speed based on difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Frustrating patterns have been adressed and are now more regularly counterable[/p][/*][*][p]New animations, new patterns and overall more visual clarity! Some patterns have been combined to make the fight more interesting[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👵 GRANNY’S QUESTS[/h1][p]The Woodlands have been out there for so long, and they still don’t have a single quest. Wtf right? Well, this update will have you meet Lady Granny and her weird shenanigans, right in the middle of her Woodlands side job! I wonder if this questline will unlock the Redwood map though… (It does)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/26f6239955f00704c3d826f75e82d8f717de053c.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]VERY WIP!! / Very not-frustrating gameplay! / Programmed by @Spinker[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/e073b819175a74d2d6a806783190384b78abc276.png"][/img][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🎃 THE SPOOKYFICATION[/h1][p]The lobby is getting ready for spooky season! This year, we’re going for a weird laboratory vibe, along with the classic field of pumpkins![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/131b6cccbf56650c44f40db9a8ac3dad199fef7a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/4d8c3996ec500dfa1bf1ed399dceae40a73a6e07.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/1db87008ed9adecc0c44bd88c7758ec983907de8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/5daf361d9300e695cb3608f10d7bf1276378bf18.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Level Art by @Borealis, atmosphere by @Spinker[/i][/p][p][/p][p]As we stated in the previous [url="https://farfarwest.notion.site/p/DEVLOG-SEPTEMBER-01-3ce64c4ffa108082a4b5e0a5fde8f433?pvs=24"]🎃[b][u]DEVLOG - SEPTEMBER - 01[/u][/b][/url], we wanted to make the game a tad more spooky overall! Lucky for us, Area 41 was just waiting for it, and got even stranger![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/6b3389554c114ba062f7eebde1471667f6a6bbee.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/e658d97ab1ec79a89d1c03eec293771f1e72bfe4.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Level Art by @Borealis[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Spooky season means spooky characters! All of these characters will be available to unlock through our upcoming Halloween event, then vaulted until the next spooky season![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/9b8e7ab1af5de3f664790910b1df9615b90870ee.png"][/img][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f171e5695f200b3df78832adc3281f466ed31254.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Rig by @Adrian[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/088ebbfcb40ce02cc37e05ed91e4ff7b657e2525.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Concept by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/87aab6b46b07a9fc6d8d5345beb4c23a06efeeae.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]3D by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/bb60d9bc2698c32e55c53d3766d2a6f476a167a0.png"][/img][i]WORK-IN-PROGRESS!! Concept and 3D by @Capp // might be a boss? who knows? (me, I know)[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👢 FEMALE HERO SKINS TO THE FRONT![/h1][p]In line with our goal of balancing out the number of skins between male and female characters, 3 new female skins are making their way into the game for Halloween as well![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/fb3f5531c11158a357425cede2bee1daf77fb8e5.png"][/img][i]Original concept by @Shoony (community), reinterpretation and 3D by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/cbe438edc7ece4a4e4b5a3779d687083c77f5a4e.png"][/img][i]Original concept by @EarlGoupil (community), reinterpretation and 3D by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/65669a151beca86d3b397967862e1751d93ddb04.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt, rig by @Adrian, animation by @Calu[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]🔫 WEAPON SKINS[/h1][p]On the side, we’re still researching themes for all of our weapon skins, and making sure we’re ready when the time comes! Here’s a bunch of new models made since the last devlog.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/c05be6c87dfbe1f02e939d034d2554b55dca9f3d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2d94660f405e1481bb8f605cdc336ed2f3c5b869.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f69975fee4640fc0802424c9030b9034b06f12c8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/030a096208c6f18e91e7d8e56fd9ce23a8048f2b.png"][/img][i]Concept and 3D by @MashArt[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👻 DISCONNECTIONS, CRASHES & FRAMERATE ISSUES[/h1][p]We’re still hunting the disconnections and crashes that have been happening since the game launched, but we’re also aware that the recent update brought new issues of the same kind. Thanks to the new tools presented in our previous [url="https://app.notion.com/DEVLOG-SEPTEMBER-01-3ce64c4ffa108082a4b5e0a5fde8f433?pvs=21"]DEVLOG - SEPTEMBER - 01[/url], we’re doing all we can to hunt them down as well! A lot of things are being reworked internally (for the greater long-term good!), which unfortunately means a few new issues have appeared along the way.[/p][p]As for optimization in general, we found new ways to increase your framerate by fiddling with our different systems! These improvements apply to everyone, but people hosting lobbies, especially on higher difficulties, should see the most difference when the update comes around.[/p][p]We’re doing all we can to fix disconnections, but obviously they can still happen. Because of this, we’ve implemented a feature that has been asked for a LOT!
[b]-> If you reconnect to a game you’ve been disconnected from, you will now get your found Jokers BACK![/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]⛳ VERY IMPORTANT LAST NOTE[/h1][p]We’re playing [u][url="https://kindahardgolf.com/"]Kinda Hard Golf[/url][/u] (you should try it!) every week with the team, and since I am the one writing the devlogs, I can do whatever I want. Thus, it’s only natural that I post last week’s results, since I won and I am unequivocally the best g@m3r at Evil Raptor. Thank you for your attention to this matter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/42ecd3ec718a2e7969ecceff5764205483e342d6.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]👋 SEE YOU LATER![/h1][p]New fanarts have also been added to the lobby, the halloween event is shaping up and more! Stay tuned.[/p][p][b]THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3[/b][/p][p]See you in the next one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img][/p]

newsitems.author: Damian | Fireshine Games
newsitems.contents:
[p]Howdy folks, Arno here! In today’s devlog, you’ll see what we’re currently working on, what’s coming in the next update, and more details on how we’re getting there![/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Everything below is [b]WORK IN PROGRESS[/b] and might not ship as shown. We’re still cookin’ for now! ⚠️[/p][hr][/hr][h1]👻 THE SPOOKYFICATION[/h1][p]We have robots, we have skeletons, we have magic, we have close close east. We feel like there’s still something missing in the overall mood, and it’s THE SPOOK. While we are [b]not[/b] going to make the game completely spooky and Halloween-esque all the time, we think that increasing the spookiness by ~20% will help the different maps feel more alive and interesting to go through. This means that all atmospheres will go through a lil’ bit of spookyfication that will [b]remain after Halloween has passed![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/9cbe88882bde3f0823fb2ea6dab24c91f4370838.png"][/img][i]Over the top paintover concept for Canyon by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/6d882b619861fae4374318fb3d7572a9ebc741ed.png"][/img][i]Way over the top paintover concept for Woodlands by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/3c2ba4ec129b340d2ceca6be31b390d2db0f428a.png"][/img][i]Part of the reference board by @Capp[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Also, we’ve been loving Halloween for a long time, so I’m going to [b]shamelessly [/b]self-plug our first game Pumpkin Jack, which is available right here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186640/Pumpkin_Jack/"][/dynamiclink][i](IT’S 88% OFF RIGHT NOW! If you’re reading this devlog later on, don’t buy it at full price! The game is on sale almost all the time 🙈)[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🎃 THE REDWOOD SPOOKYFICATION[/h1][p]A giant forest, tall trees and climbable platforms? Sure. But for now, it’s gonna be a spooky giant forest, with spooky tall trees and spooky climbable platforms 👻[/p][p][/p][p][i]Once the Halloween event is over, pumpkins will vanish from this map[/i][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a5a540194fedcdcc89390b66ca8513b273518a87.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f4f34d0baa67fae311c4dc17f41fc6b254a858b7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/496da34b361b06be482db66d10a70c14e88d4e4d.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Level Design & Level Art by @Borealis, atmosphere by @Spinker[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]👢 BANGER SKINS INCOMING[/h1][p]Two new ladies are here to rock the battlefield! One is covered in actually not-useful armor, the other in completely inadequate but very stylish clothing. Choose your fighter wisely![/p][p][/p][p]More skins will come specifically for our Halloween event, but we haven’t worked on them yet. Maybe in the next devlog? 👻[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/a353311140fcb12a6cf46e5ef27b7f29ffc92539.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concept and 3D model by @MashArt, polished and rigged by @Adri[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/1d964bddfba41ac34e9b33727452eeb877f40717.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]WIP Idle animation by @Calu[/i][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/7655392da3413795e528679dc5caca829e54c620.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f35b698b99d86b6ce4194d749e8ec0f86a700603.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Original idea by @EarlGoupil (community), 3D model by @Capp, rigged by @Adri, animated by @Calu[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🔫 WEAPON SKINS THAT GIVE YOU A RUN FOR YOUR MONEY[/h1][p]You’ve been waiting to spend your blueprints and gold for quite some time now, and you’ve been waiting for weapon skins just as long. I’m happy to announce that we’ve started working hard on them! At the moment, our artists [b]@Capp[/b] and [b]@MashArt[/b] are exploring different themes to see what works best in the game. More news on this in the weeks leading up to the feature being ready![/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/3502fa2254d7a893e2d9d36e4143cce2119bd293.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2bc618e8d65aa330eb372f482690f4e6c29d415f.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concepts and 3D model by @MashArt[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0a0612d3233424d16d53abc8c802a3df801235d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/78a106e6e9fa0ff5a798ba9c9e8afa679ccd60c5.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Concept and 3D model by @Capp[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🎯 GAME DESIGN, EVERYWHERE, ALL AT ONCE[/h1][p]Before any feature or content appears in the game, it needs to be designed. As planned in our [url="https://app.notion.com/PUBLIC-ROADMAP-3bd64c4ffa1080879561e5c6bbf6dada?pvs=21"]PUBLIC ROADMAP[/url], work has started on our Halloween event, new objectives, ways to (fairly) increase the difficulty of the game, and weekly jokers. I’m also happy to announce that [b]@Jonathan[/b] is joining our crew starting this week, and is already handling the [b]rework of our Cryptic bosses[/b] before getting his hands on the new Zurker bosses![/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/87121d4ffef79e143839c61fcd2c74188843bb62.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/2ad1420894e736dcc3793a939aa34f3b26a19f9b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/04db6ec2a2fa522eef6dfb84c8f03557a4ff8c68.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]WIP game design ideas by @Jonathan, not showing much as it’s very early![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/54a3f7e41c44ffcc0e3c45173776b57eb853ba17.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Game design for the upcoming update by @me, can’t show much yet...[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/4a88d8930e0afb40c7d4d5a209c3e1fa4466ffb3.png"][/img][/p][p][i]you didn’t see anything[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🗑️ THE CRASHES ARE HAUNTING US, WE’RE HUNTING THEM BACK![/h1][p]In the last devlog [url="https://app.notion.com/DEVLOG-EARLY-JULY-2026-39564c4ffa1081b2a536c4ce99a944d0?pvs=21"]DEVLOG EARLY-JULY 2026[/url], I mentioned that [b]@Teeto[/b] was joining us for everything tech-related. Among many things, he set us up with Sentry, a very useful tool that gives us detailed logs to identify exactly what goes wrong when you crash. [b]In only a few days, 3 of the 5 main causes of crashes have been FIXED![/b] We are hard at work fixing the game, bug by bug, even the most troublesome ones![/p][p]Of course, all the data we receive is [b]anonymous[/b], and we only get the crash logs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/22b5abb050f8cda4a586363654a97ca37f8e178a.png"][/img][i]Tool setup by @Teeto[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Random disconnections are also extremely annoying to run into as a player, especially when they make you lose a lot of progress. Just like for crashes, Sentry receives logs when a player gets disconnected, and it has already helped us fix the main cause of disconnects![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/3e098a0704fd0ae59ff4fe0b677d1abfd11bc45c.png"][/img][i]Tool setup by @Teeto[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🐛 THE BUGS, THE BUGS![/h1][p]You’ve been reporting MANY bugs since the Frostburn update dropped, and we’ve been reading every single one of them. For context, here are the statistics we released earlier this week:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f5bbb3beed760002fe0d74f00624bc560dcb64ab.png"][/img][i]Image by @me, like it please[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Even more bugs have been reported since, and I’m happy to say that almost all of them have been fixed by [b]@Spinker[/b] and [b]@Mylan[/b]! Of course, since game development is that easy, fixing bugs makes other bugs happen, so the hunt never ends. Still, we’re committed to KILLING THEM ALL![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/14873885806586aae155f163b4e1c6a577555a0b.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h1]🖥️ OPTIMIZATION! WE ALL LOVE OPTIMIZATION![/h1][p]We’ve been committed from the start to optimizing Far Far West as much as we could, to make sure it runs smoothly on as many computers as possible, and we constantly look for new ways to make the game run better. We’ve all heard the criticism about optimization on Unreal Engine 5, and that motivates us even more to make Far Far West a game that proves it can be done! If you’re nerdy enough to dig into the technical side of things, I’m leaving you with two videos from experts on the subject that helped us find new ways to optimize, on top of [b]@Spinker[/b]’s own work![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="3qgd4glfIR0;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="kJPqrvB0fdo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’re also dedicated to making the game run well on more unusual setups, through workarounds and different launch options (support for Vulkan SM5 incoming!)[/p][hr][/hr][h1]👋 SEE YOU LATER![/h1][p]There are also some improvements to a few visuals, some balancing for the upcoming patch, and a few things that aren’t quite ready to be shown yet, but no worries, they’re coming soon! 🤠[/p][p][b]THANK YOU for playing Far Far West and sticking with us <3[/b][/p][p]See you in the next one. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img][/p]

newsitems.title: FROSTBURN IS OUT NOW! - v0.2.0.2
newsitems.author: Damian | Fireshine Games
newsitems.contents:
[p]Howdy y’all! 
[/p][p][b]Frostburn is officially out now![/b]
[/p][p]Before we get into everything that’s packed into this update, we wanted to quickly follow up on something we mentioned in our last post.
[/p][p]We know it’s been a little quiet from us for a while, and we said we’d start opening the curtains a bit more on what’s happening behind the scenes. The truth is, the last few months absolutely [b]knocked us sideways[/b]. The release was a huge moment for our small team, and after everything that came with it, we needed some time to rest and recover. From here on out, we’ll be sharing more regular progress updates and dev blogs, so you can follow along with how Far Far West is coming together.
[/p][p]We’ve also put together a roadmap for Far Far West, giving you a rough idea of what we’re planning to add to the game and when you can expect to see it. Obviously, things can change at any time as development continues, but we wanted to give you a better idea of where we’re heading.[/p][h2]
[url="https://farfarwest.notion.site/"][b]-> ROADMAP <-[/b][/url][url="https://farfarwest.notion.site/"] [/url][/h2][p][/p][h2][b]FFW ON DISCOUNT![/b][/h2][p]ALSO! For the next [b]TWO WEEKS[/b] Far Far West will be [b]discounted[/b] by [b]20%[/b]! So if you or your pals have been waiting for some new content or a sweet discount to ride into the west, FROSTBURN is for y’all![/p][p][i](Discount asset?)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Alright[/b], enough talk. Let’s get into the…[/p][p][/p][h1][b]FROSTBURN UPDATE![/b][/h1][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b8803f52d562f9cdf61d022c21c83af51ac28a0f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hksz7LBZAsc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]DISCLAIMER!![/b][/h3][p]Last final small disclaimer:[/p][p]There have been some issues with AMD Frame Generation across multiple titles. If you encounter any kind of performance issues or crashes, please make sure to try turning AMD FSR ON or OFF. AMD is looking to release a patch to resolve this issue soon, so please bear with us! <3[/p][p][/p][h2][b]FEATURES/CONTENT[/b][/h2][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚔️[b]ITEM FRAGMENTS [/b][/h3][p][i]The way item fragments worked was complicated, and not many people understood it until they had a few games under their belt. It was also a big hassle to remember to start tracking another item every time you were done with one. This new system simplifies everything by making them a universal currency.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Item Fragments[/b] are now called [b]Blueprints[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tracking items to earn their blueprints is gone. You now collect blueprints during missions like you do any currency, and can then use them at the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]You no longer need to pay gold to buy a weapon after unlocking it. Spending blueprints to unlock them will directly purchase them[/p][/*][*][p]🚨 [b]All your accumulated blueprints on each weapon have been aggregated and converted to the unique blueprint currency[/b] 🚨[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🚨 LIGHTHOUSES [/b][/h3][p][i]We figured that most of the time, people almost never stumbled upon the Copy Press, the Refiner, or any other unique location, even though they did spawn in the mission. The main way to find them was to recognize their shape on the mini-map. Well, we’re adding a proper way of discovering what spawned on your map through lighthouses![/i]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/5b9e0361c7de48bb938cd964b2c80a5299cb7696.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lighthouses spawn in every mission and are indicated on your mini-map[/p][/*][*][p]Reaching the top of a lighthouse (we know you’ll use spells to cheat your way up) and completing its minigame reveals the map and its unique locations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]☢️ URANIUM[/b][/h3][p][i]You previously had to spend Gold to buy, copy or refine jokers during your games, which was annoying since Gold is also the money used to unlock long-term things in the lobby. We’re adding a new currency that only exists in-mission, so that using the tools available in-game never feels like a waste anymore. You also earn Uranium by completing quests & secrets, making sure replaying either of those is never useless. Finally, as the joker list keeps expanding, so does the chance of stumbling upon jokers you don’t like. You’ll now be able to break those jokers and get Uranium instead, then spend it on whatever you want.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/22fd9e1fb3775dc86bfc5ec3a44ddcab74c5bf2b.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Anything that costs currency during a mission now uses Uranium instead of Gold[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Leftover Uranium at the end of a mission is converted into XP for your hero and your weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Uranium can be collected in different ways:[/p][list][*][p]Break a Joker [i]\[[b]NEW:[/b] hit a Joker with your fists to break it][/i][/p][list][*][p]The amount of Uranium depends on the rarity of the broken joker[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped jokers do not give Uranium[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Kill an Elite enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Complete a secondary objective[/p][/*][*][p]Complete a quest[/p][/*][*][p]Complete a secret[/p][/*][*][p]Complete a lighthouse[/p][/*][*][p]Unique Uranium objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Flying balloons[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🥊 MELEE WEAPONS[/b][/h3][p][i]MELEE WEAPOOOOOOOOOOONS! You’ve asked for them A LOT, and here they are! Melee weapons bring a new way of playing Far Far West, each with its own playstyle, just like the ranged weapons. They don’t use a dedicated slot and will replace either your primary or your secondary weapon, so make sure you can still kill every enemy with your setup before going into missions! newsitems.title: Frostburn is Coming August 27!
newsitems.author: Damian | Fireshine Games
newsitems.contents:
[p]Howdy, y’all![/p][p][b]We know it’s been a while.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve seen the comments, the questions, the [i]“when update?”[/i] messages. We know you’ve been waiting, and we really appreciate y’all sticking with us[/p][p]The honest answer is that a [b]lot has been happening behind the scenes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re a small indie team, and when we launched Far Far West into the world, we definitely didn’t expect the level of love and success that came our way. It’s been AMAZING!! [i]But[/i] it’s also meant taking a step back and making sure we were ready for what comes next.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the last few months, we’ve been doing a lot of work that isn’t particularly exciting to show in a trailer,[b] reworking internal structures, expanding the team, improving how we work, and figuring out what the future of Far Far West should actually look like.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been taking our time with this because we want to hold ourselves to the same standards we’ve always had for the game. We don’t just want to throw updates out the door for the sake of having something to show.[/p][p][/p][p]And now, we’re ready to start showing you what we’ve been working on.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Introducing the FROSTBURN UPDATE![/b][/h2][p]On [b]August 27th[/b], our next major update for FFW arrives[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/b8803f52d562f9cdf61d022c21c83af51ac28a0f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Full details on the update will be available on launch day! For now put your guesses for the update in the comments [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Play Frostburn First at Gamescom[/b][/h2][p]If you’re heading to [b]Gamescom[/b], you’ll actually be able to get your hands on Frostburn [b]a full 24 HOURS[/b] [b]before anyone else.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]🗓️26th August, 1PM (CET) | Booth 131, Hall 10.2[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Come say hi, play the new update, let us know what you think and grab your very own FFW cowboy hat [i](while stocks last).[/i] We can’t wait to meet y’all![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/75a4cc5647ba7bd8a0d0f400707171f98dbe98ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/bbd015514a767fe9bae788cdf6abdec03f23d6d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for hanging around while we’ve been busy behind the scenes. [i]We know the wait hasn’t been the most fun[/i], but we think you’ll understand why we took the time once you start seeing what we’ve been working towards.[/p][p][/p][p]The dust is starting to settle. [b]Frostburn is coming.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See y’all in the Far (Far) West[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/0686893f8e9435eeeddbab0e9a45c4e0de5a116f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]- The Far Far West Team[/b] 🤠🌵[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Follow us through the West![/b][/h2][p][b]Don’t forget to [url="https://linktr.ee/FarFarWest"][u]follow our socials[/u][/url][/b] [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/farfarwest"][b]Join our Discord[/b][/url]
